criteria.requirement: Implement dotenv.editing.update_keys(path, updates, *, remove=(), encoding="utf-8", follow_symlinks=False). Validate and serialize the complete mapping/removal list before opening rewrite; reject malformed keys, NUL/nonstring values and conflicting update/delete keys. Reuse rewrite for one atomic replacement, preserve every non-target parsed record and newline byte, update first target occurrence and remove duplicate target definitions, remove all requested-key occurrences, append missing updates in mapping order with a needed separator, and return (updated_keys_tuple, removed_keys_tuple). Single-quote escaping must roundtrip backslashes, quotes and multiline values. Preserve mode, symlink option and failure cleanup.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
